notes:
Inbound trial from product signup. Founder (CTO) — Jake Moreno — demo request via chat widget 2026-03-01. Wants to ship an in-app assistant inside their CRM product for SMB customers. Key quote: "Need streaming replies that feel real-time on mobile — p50 < 200ms ideally." Short deck reviewed (drive link).

Initial call 2026-03-02: Maya (AE) intro + high-level roadmap. Focus: hosted API, streaming + token cost control. Mentioned they evaluate open-source and OpenAI; price sensitive.

Technical details from SE sync: prototype uses client-side websocket to stream tokens, current mock latency ~350ms p50 on east coast devices; spikes on cell networks. Wants suggestions on batching, prefix caching, and model routing. No legal/regulatory residency needs. SOC2 in roadmap but not blocking.

Requested artifacts: 1) short how-to for streaming SDK integration (web + react-native), 2) recommended model profiles for 2–4 token/s budget, 3) example fallback policy for degraded network (low bandwidth).

Quote from CTO in follow-up: "If we can get consistent <250ms p50 on mobile we can justify going GA."

Sales/ops notes: self-serve signup converted to qualified lead based on usage signals (burst of 1k tokens during test). Sent initial trial key 2026-03-03. Perf test scheduled 2026-03-06 with SE (Liam) to reproduce streaming path from mobile.

Next immediate: deliver pre-configured perf test harness + sample React Native streaming snippet. Blocker: budget — ask to propose a 3-month pilot credit structure.

CRM shorthand: inbound -> trial -> perf-test pending -> ask for pilot pricing. Follow-up cadence: 2x/week until perf test complete.
